name: Deadlocked in Time
source: This is the story of a boy who no longer appreciates life, after which his father sent him from private school to public, everything just changed for him. As a result, he is bullied by his classmates, his grades are so bad that even his future is in danger, and he is constantly skipping school. The only people who get along with him are his friends and girlfriend who, like him, have no interest in school and share the same views. One day, when his life is slowly but surely improving, something strange happens, time stands still, the sun doesn't set anymore and night never falls. Everyone is in a kind of Stasys and can't move anymore, except you.
